content: To screen for type 2 diabetes in youth, the American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends performing a fasting plasma glucose test or a 75-gram oral glucose tolerance test. Hemoglobin A1C testing can be used as a secondary test to identify prediabetes or diabetes. In cases where youth are diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and also present with obesity, it is recommended to screen for pancreatic autoantibodies. This is done to exclude the possibility of autoimmune type 1 diabetes.
